GRPC_HOST.help: Full upstream value used by grpc_pass (for example grpc://app:50051 or grpcs://app:443).
GRPC_HOST.label: gRPC host

GRPC_URL.help: Location URL that will be proxied to a gRPC upstream.
GRPC_URL.label: gRPC URL

GRPC_CUSTOM_HOST.help: Override Host header sent to gRPC upstream.
GRPC_CUSTOM_HOST.label: gRPC custom host

GRPC_HEADERS.help: List of headers to send to gRPC upstream separated with semicolons (values for grpc_set_header directive).
GRPC_HEADERS.label: gRPC headers

GRPC_HIDE_HEADERS.help: List of headers to hide from clients when received from gRPC upstream (values for grpc_hide_header directive).
GRPC_HIDE_HEADERS.label: gRPC hide headers

GRPC_HEADERS_CLIENT.help: List of headers to send to client separated with semicolons (values for add_header directive).
GRPC_HEADERS_CLIENT.label: gRPC headers-client

GRPC_PASS_HEADERS.help: List of headers to pass through from the gRPC upstream to the client even when they are hidden by default, separated with spaces (values for grpc_pass_header directive).
GRPC_PASS_HEADERS.label: gRPC pass headers

GRPC_IGNORE_HEADERS.help: List of headers from the gRPC upstream that must not be processed by NGINX, separated with spaces (values for grpc_ignore_headers directive).
GRPC_IGNORE_HEADERS.label: gRPC ignore headers

GRPC_INTERCEPT_ERRORS.help: Intercept and rewrite HTTP error responses from the gRPC upstream (does not inspect the gRPC status in response trailers).
GRPC_INTERCEPT_ERRORS.label: Intercept errors

GRPC_BUFFER_SIZE.help: Value for grpc_buffer_size directive (size of the buffer used for reading the response from the gRPC upstream).
GRPC_BUFFER_SIZE.label: gRPC buffer size

GRPC_CONNECT_TIMEOUT.help: Timeout when connecting to the gRPC upstream.
GRPC_CONNECT_TIMEOUT.label: gRPC connect timeout

GRPC_READ_TIMEOUT.help: Timeout when reading from the gRPC upstream.
GRPC_READ_TIMEOUT.label: gRPC read timeout

GRPC_SEND_TIMEOUT.help: Timeout when sending to the gRPC upstream.
GRPC_SEND_TIMEOUT.label: gRPC send timeout

GRPC_SOCKET_KEEPALIVE.help: Enable or disable keepalive for gRPC upstream sockets.
GRPC_SOCKET_KEEPALIVE.label: gRPC socket keepalive

GRPC_SSL_SNI.help: Enable or disable sending SNI to gRPC upstream server.
GRPC_SSL_SNI.label: SSL SNI

GRPC_SSL_SNI_NAME.help: Sets the SNI host to send to gRPC upstream server.
GRPC_SSL_SNI_NAME.label: SSL SNI name

GRPC_SSL_VERIFY.help: Enable or disable verification of the gRPC upstream server's SSL certificate.
GRPC_SSL_VERIFY.label: SSL verify

GRPC_SSL_TRUSTED_CERTIFICATE_PRIORITY.help: Source of the trusted CA certificate: file path or base64/PEM data (file or data).
GRPC_SSL_TRUSTED_CERTIFICATE_PRIORITY.label: Trusted certificate priority

GRPC_SSL_TRUSTED_CERTIFICATE.help: Path to a PEM CA bundle used to verify the gRPC upstream certificate (priority 'file', readable by the scheduler, which caches and distributes it). Required for verification; for public upstreams use the system bundle (e.g. /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt). If unset, verification is disabled.
GRPC_SSL_TRUSTED_CERTIFICATE.label: SSL trusted certificate path

GRPC_SSL_TRUSTED_CERTIFICATE_DATA.help: Trusted CA certificate as base64 or plaintext PEM (priority 'data').
GRPC_SSL_TRUSTED_CERTIFICATE_DATA.label: Trusted certificate data (base64/plaintext)

GRPC_SSL_VERIFY_DEPTH.help: Sets the verification depth in the gRPC upstream server certificates chain.
GRPC_SSL_VERIFY_DEPTH.label: SSL verify depth

GRPC_SSL_CERT_PRIORITY.help: Source of the client certificate and key presented to the gRPC upstream server: file path or base64/PEM data (file or data).
GRPC_SSL_CERT_PRIORITY.label: Client certificate priority

GRPC_SSL_CERT.help: Path to a PEM client certificate presented to the gRPC upstream server for mutual TLS (priority 'file', readable by the scheduler, which caches and distributes it). Requires GRPC_SSL_KEY.
GRPC_SSL_CERT.label: Client certificate path

GRPC_SSL_CERT_DATA.help: Client certificate as base64 or plaintext PEM (priority 'data').
GRPC_SSL_CERT_DATA.label: Client certificate data (base64/plaintext)

GRPC_SSL_KEY.help: Path to the PEM private key matching GRPC_SSL_CERT (priority 'file', readable by the scheduler). The key must not be encrypted.
GRPC_SSL_KEY.label: Client key path

GRPC_SSL_KEY_DATA.help: Client private key as base64 or plaintext PEM (priority 'data').
GRPC_SSL_KEY_DATA.label: Client key data (base64/plaintext)

GRPC_SSL_CRL.help: Path to a PEM certificate revocation list used when verifying the gRPC upstream server. Takes precedence over GRPC_SSL_CRL_DATA. Only applied when GRPC_SSL_VERIFY is yes.
GRPC_SSL_CRL.label: CRL path

GRPC_SSL_CRL_DATA.help: Certificate revocation list as base64 or plaintext PEM. Used only when the CRL path setting is empty.
GRPC_SSL_CRL_DATA.label: CRL data (base64/plaintext)

GRPC_SSL_PROTOCOLS.help: TLS versions offered to the gRPC upstream server (value of the grpc_ssl_protocols directive). Empty keeps the NGINX default.
GRPC_SSL_PROTOCOLS.label: Upstream SSL protocols

GRPC_SSL_CIPHERS.help: Cipher suite string offered to the gRPC upstream server (value of the grpc_ssl_ciphers directive). Empty keeps the NGINX default.
GRPC_SSL_CIPHERS.label: Upstream SSL ciphers

GRPC_NEXT_UPSTREAM.help: Conditions for selecting the next gRPC upstream server.
GRPC_NEXT_UPSTREAM.label: gRPC next upstream

GRPC_NEXT_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT.help: Time limit for passing a request to the next gRPC upstream server.
GRPC_NEXT_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT.label: gRPC next upstream timeout

GRPC_NEXT_UPSTREAM_TRIES.help: Maximum number of attempts for passing a request to the next gRPC upstream server.
GRPC_NEXT_UPSTREAM_TRIES.label: gRPC next upstream tries

GRPC_AUTH_REQUEST.help: Enable authentication using an external provider (value of auth_request directive).
GRPC_AUTH_REQUEST.label: gRPC auth request

GRPC_AUTH_REQUEST_SIGNIN_URL.help: Redirect clients to sign-in URL when using GRPC_AUTH_REQUEST (used when auth_request call returned 401). NGINX variables such as $scheme, $host and $request_uri are supported.
GRPC_AUTH_REQUEST_SIGNIN_URL.label: Auth request signin URL

GRPC_AUTH_REQUEST_SET.help: List of variables to set from the authentication provider, separated with semicolons (values of auth_request_set directives).
GRPC_AUTH_REQUEST_SET.label: gRPC auth request set

GRPC_INCLUDES.help: Additional configuration to include in the gRPC location block, separated with spaces.
GRPC_INCLUDES.label: gRPC includes

GRPC_MAX_CLIENT_SIZE.help: Maximum body size for this gRPC location (0 for infinite). When empty, the service MAX_CLIENT_SIZE applies.
GRPC_MAX_CLIENT_SIZE.label: gRPC maximum body size
